config.siteTitle: N Arch Builders & Designers | Sulthan Bathery, Wayanad
config.metaDescription: N Arch is a 100% Wayanad-focused architectural design and turnkey construction firm based in Sulthan Bathery. Specialized in hill terrain villas, traditional Kerala Nalukettu, monsoon engineering, and luxury interiors across Wayanad.
config.address: Opposite Victory Hospital, Near Matha Theatre, Sulthan Bathery, Wayanad, Kerala - 673592

services.name: Construction
services.short: Turnkey residential & commercial building engineered for Wayanad terrain.
services.long: End-to-end building construction optimized for Wayanad’s red laterite soil, stepped hill slopes, and heavy monsoon rains. Supervised daily by our in-house civil engineers from Bathery.
pts: Contour foundations & stepped retaining walls for hill slopes
Monsoon-grade waterproofing, deep eaves & clay tiled roofing
Sulthan Bathery, Kalpetta & Mananthavady municipality approval handling
Turnkey execution from soil testing to key handover

services.name: Interiors
services.short: Spaces planned for Wayanad’s climate, mist, and natural lifestyle.
services.long: Custom interior architecture using boiling waterproof (BWP) materials, warm Kerala teak joinery, and natural ventilation designed to prevent hill humidity and mist dampness.
pts: Moisture-resistant BWP modular kitchens & wardrobes
Heritage central Nadumuttam courtyards with wooden Oonjal
Warm ambient LED lighting designed for misty Wayanad evenings
Teak, Anjili & fluted timber acoustic wall cladding

services.name: 3D Elevation
services.short: Photorealistic 3D elevations visualized on your actual Wayanad plot.
services.long: Detailed 3D exterior renders that factor in your plot’s natural slope, tree cover, and sunlight orientation before breaking ground in Wayanad.
pts: Front, side, and 360-degree hill perspective renders
Traditional Kerala Nalukettu & contemporary modern villa palettes
Daylight, heavy monsoon rain & evening ambient lighting simulations
Unlimited revisions until your family approves the final design

services.name: Renovation
services.short: Restoring and expanding ancestral homes and plantation bungalows.
services.long: Specialized structural reinforcement, damp-proofing, and modern functional upgrades for older Wayanad residences and estate bungalows without losing heritage character.
pts: Monsoon damp-proof courses (DPC) & roof re-tiling solutions
Ancestral Nalukettu timber restoration & modernization
Vertical floor extensions with RCC structural load enhancement
Contemporary kitchen & modern bathroom remodelling

services.name: Landscaping
services.short: Monsoon-tested outdoor architecture, stone paving & slope gardens.
services.long: Outdoor hill architecture designed to manage heavy monsoon rainwater runoff, prevent soil erosion, and blend seamlessly into Wayanad’s coffee and tea estate surroundings.
pts: Engineered retaining walls with weep holes & drainage channels
Grass-paver driveways, natural granite steps & boundary walls
Native tropical flora, mist garden planning & lawn stabilization
Concealed rainwater harvesting & stormwater diversion systems
